messages:
maria: Postmortem follow-up: recurring partial streams + timeouts during 03/29 08:30-10:00 UTC. Pattern: long tail token generations (>20s) -> proxy RST_STREAM. Need owners for quick mitigations.

lee: Seen in traces. Short fix: bump proxy idle-timeout and enable server keepalive/flush. Mid: SDK resume/backoff.

sagar: Logs: `RST_STREAM reason=idle_timeout` from envoy. No app-level pings during long gens.

harry: Ops can run a canary for timeout bump. Need a narrow blast radius and rollback plan.

ops-bot: Ticket INF-5201 created: "streaming - timeout canary" assigned to ops-oncall.

lee: I'll open SDK PR for resume token + exp backoff with jitter. ETA PR: 2026-03-31.

sagar: I'll prototype HTTP/2 PING in runtime and test in staging. Early run reduced resets in staging.

maria: Action items: A1 timeout canary -> owner: harry -> due: 2026-03-30; A2 runtime keepalive -> owner: sagar -> due: 2026-04-02; A3 SDK resume/backoff -> owner: lee -> due: 2026-04-05; A4 add metric streaming.partial_rate -> owner: maria -> due: 2026-03-31. Weekly sync Friday 10:00 UTC. Update checklist.

harry: Ops accepted canary window 2026-03-30 02:00-03:00 UTC.

maria: Closing for updates; reply here if blocked.
